headline: A law that names the Jackie Robinson Ballpark in Daytona Beach, Florida, a national commemorative site and orders a federal study of its historic importance.
what_it_does: The act designates the Jackie Robinson Ballpark in Daytona Beach, Florida, as the Jackie Robinson Ballpark National Commemorative Site. It adds the site to the African American Civil Rights Network. It also directs the Department of the Interior to study whether the site is nationally significant and whether it could become a national historic landmark.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 4, 2025. The official summary does not list a separate effective date.
